final_message: BRIEF.md is written. It recomputes each key figure from the underlying source data rather than trusting each packet's stated summary, and flags three discrepancies in Notes: finance's stated spend total is $750 short of its own line-item sum, support's stated close rate (96.4%) doesn't match its own ticket counts (actual 93.7%), and delivery's stated launch date (10-22) is off by one business day from the recomputed schedule (10-23). Security's figure checked out cleanly.
